messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts from region us-west-1 observed on gateway-prod. Paging primary oncall @Nora L
Nora L: acknowledged. I'm looking at gateway and batcher metrics. Started ~7m ago. 5xx jump to ~9% for text-gen routes
Sam G: shadowing. initial glance: batcher pool `primary` queue length exploded. many requests stuck in 'waiting for batch' state. p95 queue_time > 15s
Diego M: Confirming logs show head-of-line blocking: older requests preventing newer ones due to giant batches waiting on cold-KV re-warms. Seen repeated "prefetch-kv: miss" entries
Priya K: Customer impact: several production tenants are reporting streaming disconnects and 500 responses. Notifying CS to prepare possible outbound comms
Nora L: mitigation plan I propose (tiered): 1) immediate fast-fail for non-critical routes (fail at 6s) 2) reduce default batch_size from 32->10 for pool=primary 3) temporarily enable opportunistic routing to secondary pool in eu-west-1 for overflow 4) restart the suspect scheduler pod once drained
Sam G: runbook step 1: apply fast-fail at gateway: `kubectl -n gateway patch configmap/gateway-config --patch '{"data":{"fast_fail_timeout":"6s","routes_non_sla":["/v1/generate"]}}'`
ops-bot: apply job accepted by platform. job_id=job-5567
Diego M: reducing batch size config now -> `opsctl config set-inference --pool primary --batch-size 10 --immediate=true`
Nora L: toggling shedder for demo and dev tenants: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/thresholds -d '{"pool":"primary","shed_rate":0.25,"targets":["/v1/stream","/internal/demo"]}'`
Priya K: good. I'm coordinating with CS: affected tenants (prelim): FastDocs, RetailOne, internal-e2e. I'll prepare a short comm with time window and mitigations
Sam G: metric dump:
```
# prometheus snippets
batcher_queue_length{pool="primary"} -> 1780
batcher_batch_wait_seconds_p95 -> 18.9
gateway_5xx_rate{region="us-west-1"} -> 0.092
scheduler_pod_memory_jvm -> pod/scheduler-22 ~ 1.8Gi (OOM-kernel activity)
```
Nora L: I see one scheduler instance with heavy memory churn (scheduler-22). Diego, can you cordon it and drain? We'll restart after drain
Diego M: `kubectl cordon scheduler-22 -n inference` -> cordoned. Draining now.
ops-bot: drain job submitted id=drain-772
Sam G: while that drains, enabling fallback routing: `routerctl add-route-weight --from us-west-1 --to eu-west-1 --model model-quant-2 --weight 30%`
Nora L: autoscale request to add GPUs to primary pool: `autoscalerctl request --pool primary --add 4 --priority urgent --reason "INC-2104600000"`
Priya K: CS note: sending initial message to FastDocs + RetailOne: "We are investigating elevated errors and timeouts for generation endpoints. Engineers have applied temporary mitigations (reduced batching, fail-fast for non-critical routes, scaled worker pool). We'll update within 30m."
Sam G: drain completed. restarting scheduler-22: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/scheduler -n inference --field-selector metadata.name=scheduler-22`
Diego M: restart complete at ts=2104600065. Observing logs: GC frequency reduced afterwards.
Nora L: immediate effects: queue length down 1780 -> 420 in ~70s. p95 queue wait -> 4.1s. 5xx -> 1.5% (still above baseline but improving)
ops-bot: Incident log entry created: INC-2104600000 severity=P2 start_ts=2104600000
Priya K: filing incident channel and drafting customer update. adding link to status page once available
Sam G: note: we should capture heap/GC logs from scheduler-22 for RCA before it's recycled. Diego, can you dump `/var/log/jvm/heap.hprof` and upload to gs://redwood-incidents/2104600000/ ?
Diego M: copying now. `kubectl cp scheduler-22:/var/log/jvm/heap.hprof /tmp/ && gsutil cp /tmp/heap.hprof gs://redwood-incidents/2104600000/`
Nora L: good. keep shedder and reduced batch sizes for another 20m and monitor. If stable, revert shedder first, then batch size, then fallback routes
Sam G: adding an emergency queue-circuit: `opsctl set-circuit --metric batcher_queue_length --threshold 800 --action shed_non_sla` so we auto-trig if queue grows again
Priya K: Customer list final: FastDocs (errors/stream aborts), RetailOne (timeouts), internal-e2e (replayed tests). Sending comms now. ETA message: tentative full restoration within 30-60m
Nora L: monitoring graphs: p95 queue_time -> 1.9s; 5xx -> 0.4%. Good trend. Leave autoscale in progress (expected +4 GPUs in ~2m)
Sam G: followups: 1) RCA on KV cache churn + admission logic, 2) evaluate lower default batch_size for hot routes, 3) improve autoscaler react time and include preemptive circuit earlier
ops-bot: Scheduling postmortem meeting: tomorrow 09:00 PT. Incident tags: INC-2104600000, batcher-saturation, HOL-blocking
night-sre: Acknowledge handoff. I'll monitor for 2h and escalate if regressions.
Priya K: I'll send final customer update after 15m observation window
Nora L: thanks team. closing incident thread after stability window. Note to self: add ticket to runtime backlog for admission policy work
